nom: Hero Cosmetics Mighty Patch Micropoint for Blemishes Patches

avis.texte: I've never tried microneedle patches before so it was definitely odd but kinda neat to feel those at first. They dissolved overnight and it didn't actually hurt. These seem better for bringing under the skin pimples to the surface faster than they would on their own, then use the regular patches to actually absorb and heal. The patch is nicer than sleeping with normal salicylic acids on since that always stains my bedding, it's been enough of a barrier. I don't get pimples as frequently anymore so I probably won't rebuy these all the time, but they were interesting to try. Wish these existed when I was younger though

avis.titre: Dark Skin: Must Wait till Pimple Is Showing White
avis.texte: I'm a dark skin woman. I LOVE this product BUT for myself I noticed that I had to put on the patch once I started seeing a small white-head showing. My god it worked just in time for an event in a few days! (My pic would have been gross)!

I never make reviews and never really use pimple patches. I struggle with hormal acne and of course broke out before an upcoming invent i was desperate and decided to give them a try. Put this on a deep under the skin cyst and its shrunk in half the size overnight! Im so impressed! Its not gone completely but looks sooo much better!
I like these patches alot and they are not too harsh for my extremely sensitive skin

Ive been struggling with hormonal acne for the first time in my entire life, and these patches have been really helpful. I wouldnt say they totally make the proble area go away, but they definitely speed up the life cycle of the acne

I don't usually leave reviews but these patches really work. I have hormonal acne every month, at least one or two deep zits. If I use these patches overnight, the zit will calm down the next day, and either come to head sooner or flatten completely. I have used Peach slices microdart patches but these are much more effective. They've become a staple in my skin care.
I love pretty much every Hero Cosmetics product I've tried but these are a home run. Any time I feel a pimple lurking I put these on and they take care of it.

I had a gigantic cystic acne coming up right before a huge event. Thankfully, I still had a few days so I ordered these babies and OMG, they really did speed up the healing process and left my skin scar free! I used it overnight so it wouldn't be visible during the day and it really stayed put while I was sleeping. It does take a few days for things to exit your system, so if you can use these at least 5 days before any big events, if that's possible that would be ideal. They are a bit drying too, so make sure to use a deep hydrator like a hyaluronic serum for a few days after removing the patch. Also, since they are drying don't use any acids in the area, like salicylic acid, for probably a week after using and make sure to hydrate and exfoliate the area gently and regularly. I will be keeping these in my arsenal for sure!
I tried on different pimples and it didn't work with any of them. L

avis.titre: lifesavers!! amazing at deflating cystic acne
avis.texte: The normal zit patches are great, but these are AMAZING for those painful, under the skin, cystic acne. I had normal zit patches on a big cystic zit for a week, and they HELPED, but I had the micro point ones on for two days and everything deflated and didn't HURT when I moved my eyebrow. The micro point ones are bulkier than the normal ones, and there's less sticky area, so I have to make sure my skin is dry enough to adhere. They also don't hold up to splashing with water as well, but they're not made to be inconspicuous like the day time ones.
I read mixed reviews about this product so i wanted to try it iht for myself. I have it a fair chance by buying twice to see if i was using it wrong but it still didnt work for me.
It is worth the money to me. It works and I don't worry because I have these. They stick good and do it's job overnight. I use it about three nights and my zit is gone. I will always use them.

I bought these to help with some of my acne that doesn't come all the way to the surface. I use this brands pimple patches so I had high hopes for these but it seems like they've done nothing for my skin any time I've used them.

These are definitely the best pimple patches I have used. They work sooo well, got rid of my acne overnight, while the original pimple patches have never really worked out for me. The only downside to these is that you're paying $12-$14 for only 8 patches… I tend to use these pretty frequently, so that's not the greatest. However, I do think it's worth it if you're looking to get these from time to time.
Literally the BEST on the market. I tried peach slices and they dont do a thing, these ones are the ones to get!
The microdarts on this patch are too small to penetrate beneath the skin. Other brands like Zitsticka are more expensive but the microdarts are much better. These just don't work.

I never review products but I LOVE these patches!! You have to use them as directed. Within two uses, this huge deep pimple ive had for WEEKS is almost gone. I have geen trying so hard to get rhis thing to go away - it never came ro a head and has just been big and in my way. With these matches it has shrunk so fast!!
I used this on two blind pimples and they both surfaced. Very pleased
These arent worth the hype or the money. Regular Hero Mighty Patches do a better job & are much more reasonably priced. I wont be buying these again.

Do not recommend. Make my pimple worse and become nodule. Also, the microdart creates punctures and damages the skin, which eventually leads to scarring. I'd recommend other topical acne treatments or just wait until your pimple shows head and use the original patch.

I have only ever used the original Hero patches (which I swear by) but thought I'd try out the microneedle version when I noticed a potential cyst forming 2 nights before an event I was hosting. I'm so glad I did because I noticed a significant decrease in the size, redness and pressure behind the troubled area. You dont get as many patches as the original and they are a bit more noticible compared to the originals if i wear them in public but the bottom line is I would give this product 15 stars if I could!
Not what I expected, but it did the trick of taking away some inflammation and redness. It didn't do anything spectacular for the quantity or the price.

avis.titre: This is in must have acne kit!!
avis.texte: One of the best early stage acne products out there. Reduces redness and size of the acne spot overnight and gets rid of pimples in as early as two days. I literally cant live without this in my bathroom. It's my go-to acne product when any blemish arises!
These actuqlly work! I have no desire to try others after these!!
the first patch is very effective for deep blemishes but the second one doesn't do much at all. though throughout the week the blemish started to deflate and didn't form a pimple like usual

Amazing results when used as directed on very early stage deep pimples. I had one pimple that had been growing for two days and one very deep, painful one that had just formed and was not yet very visible, and when I used the patches as directed (pressing down for 20 seconds), I found that the very early one disappeared the next day, but the later stage one had little improvement. Save these for those very very early deep pimples. These will be a staple in my medicine cabinet!
Although these are spendy for how few you get, they work WONDERS to bring pimples to head. I swear by them!!

avis.titre: Good camouflage but not very good treatment
avis.texte: I like that these are clear and stick on well. I used them for a cystic pimple and it did take it down but it sort of like cant be used too many days i wouldnt do more than two cause its taking way longer to heal and honestly it was huge. I like these in combo with a different patch without the needles.

avis.titre: Like a shield for those sensitive acne
avis.texte: Love that this helped my cystic acne flare. I've worn this during the day and sometimes at night and it still clears everything up. The only thing is you have to use it on dry clean skin so I couldn't fully do my full skin care routine because it wouldn't stick. Still love < 3

I'm prone to deep pimples. I forgot that I grabbed these and patiently waited for a new pimple to come to ahead over a few weeks. It was slowly draining and I was looking for a regular pimple patch to prevent myself from picking at it. I wore it for one afternoon and the pimple totallt deflated. It also looks less red.

I dont know what the bad reviews are about. For me, the normal pimple patches dont really do much. These ones are great at bringing stubborn pimples to a head. They are expensive though, so I only use them on pimples that won't go away
These patches are a lifesaver! Works very well to take blossoming pimples.
I use pimple patches all the time. These patches above all others work the best. I will be purchasing again.

omg i got the biggest like under the skin pimple and it hurt so bad and i used two of these one for each night and THEY DID NOTHING if anything i swear it felt bigger honestly just go get urself a warm compress for the deep acne, also theres like 5 patches in there

I finally found something that helps my skin! I had about 6 pimples that were on the skin and under. I put it on that night then a second night and it worked! I highly recommend usually nothing works for my skin currently struggling with hormonal acne so to have something that works is a relief.

these patches helped get rid of the most annoying "scar" i had (a deep pimple that popped under my skin) in two days!!! i am also a victim of those painful deep itchy hormonal pimples, these literally kill them off in like two or three days. i really do wish they werent so pricey for only 8 patches, but for how well they work and how many times they've saved me, i will keep my mouth shut.

I use these for the zits that are below the surface, the ones that you start feeling long before you actually see them! And for the ones that never seem to come to the surface, if that makes sense lol! They work great!

Even when i think ive finally gotten these to stick they just pop right back off. How is it supposed to work if it wont even stay where you need it? And theyre SO expensive. Terrible terrible patches.
do not recommend if you have rosecea. works but is too harsh on sensitive skin. i am the wrong demographic for this product.
Got these for my football player having breakouts. These work so well without drying his skin out.

I got these patches because i was starting to form pimples, but when i put them on the points were weird! It feeld like super small needles are getting jabbed into your face! But its not that bad, because it can pop the pimple and the patch will suck out all of the gunk! But after about 15 minute of having it on you get used to the points on the patch and its pain free! Everytime ive used them the whole patch is white! You cant see anything through it! And my pimples look and feel a lot better! So i recommend these al lot!

I have acne-prone skin, and so I have been trying to find something that can help me stop having so many breakouts. When I tell you these are AMAZING, I am not lying! Whenever I see a pimple beginning to form, I just slap one of these on and it is way smaller and way less noticeable by the morning. Holy grail!!!

I love the hero normal pimple patches so I bought these before prom bc I had like 3 under the skin pimples show up and I was hoping these would get rid of them but no! They did not do anything. I don't think the needles even puncture the pimple. And they're so expensive. I feel like they even made my pimples worse? Like they did not take the pain away at all or even shrink them, it just hurts to peel them off in the morning and leaves a sticky residue. But all micropoint patches don't work, I've also tried those zit sticka ones which are also terrible. Just put benzoyl peroxide on your pimples or something bc this does nothing

I occasionally get nodule acne which are super painful and cannot be popped. I put these on them when I feel one coming and it is like magic. My last one, I did not catch fast enough so it came in fully but after one of these on all day, it was virtually gone!
This product definitely works! the bump was painful & very inflamed initially & I used it 3 times within 2 the days & the inflammation went down immediately completely! Definitely will buy more!

avis.titre: Licensed esthetician: Made a skeptic a believer !
avis.texte: I tell clients & friends THESE micro-point patches are a MUST HAVE! I've gone from having my cystic acne injected by my dermatologist WEEKLY to placing these on when I feel one forming. Upon patch removal, pimples are entirely flat! NO irritation!
Seriously the best brand! ALL of their products actually work on my cystic acne.

avis.titre: Never tried something like this before
avis.texte: I've never seen a similar product to this before, but I think it's been helpful for me when I feel a pimple developing. It's hard to tell, but I do think it's made a difference in the progression of the pimple.

avis.titre: saw my face, now i'm a believer!
avis.texte: received a sample of these patches that I forgot about..started to get 2 pimples on the same cheek and remembered the patches and slapped them on before a 9 hour shift at work. I mask at my job, but the patches blended into my skin (i'm yellow-based tan) to where no one would've even noticed if I wasn't wearing a mask. definitely saw the results they claim from one use and will definitely keep these patches in my beauty cabinet:)))

I was really hoping I'd be able to love this product, but unfortunately I saw no results at all. I woke up one morning to a blemish firming and immediately cleansed my face and applied a patch. I left it for 8 hours and repeated that night, and one more time the next morning. That evening, I was a fully formed pimple and it hurt. Back on the hunt I go.
These are so easy to put on and wear all day and after one wear i seen an immediate decrease in redness on a pimple

After reading some of the reviews, I was a bit skeptical of this product, but wanted to try it out for myself. I had these small pimples sort of clustered together, so I used a patch for it. After 8 hours, they were practically gone! My pimples usually come from hormonal issues, so if you want to use it for that reason, go ahead! Just make sure to use it before it becomes a white head.
These patches have all formed a bubble after following instructions and haven't helped with my pimples. I've tried them on cystic pimples and smaller pimples. Buy the regular patches instead.

Every batch I have purchased has been different, I've noticed the effectiveness of the product varies by the darte becoming kind of gummy I believe due to handling to some degree. They would be better in individual packaging. They only last for a couple hours, you can't leave it on for 8 and have it work at all. And you have to use an entire pack on a single pimple for the most part specifically for cystic acne which is what they were designed for so idk why it only works on whiteheads! I'm trying to prevent scarring here!

I love almost every product hero comes out with, infact I love most of the patches but this one left something to be desired. Used all sox patches and yet none of them seemed to do what was promised. My favorite patches hands down are the might patches for your nose. Now those do exactly what they say they do. Again all of the other products I've tried work wonders. Either way these patches not working is not serious enough for me to quit using their other products.

It's amazing. It shrank a big zit that was forming under the skin. Another came to a head the next day. I was a bit disappointed with the amount in the package. I thought there were more on the package, but a great product
This product worked great for me. Applied one patch overnight for two consecutive nights and what probably would have lasted a week was resolved! Like magic!

avis.titre: Not perfect, but way better than salicylic ackd

I have used other hero products and they definitely are effective. but these, wow. I've been having issues with cystic acne, and put one of these on a quite painful, red, and just awful cheek pimple. Omg Amazing!! I tried one for the first time, I put 1 over a cystic acne overnight, next morning it had almost completely deflated, no more pain and redness gone! I will keep purchasing, and now I'll look at other Hero products.

This has been helping reduce the amount of pimples I get. I use it in the beginning stages of a breakout and it works wonders! The application is really easy and it works quickly. I love how effective it is!

This is really good with bringing underground pimples to the surface.
absolutely love this product. truly gets rid of those painful pimples after a few uses.

avis.titre: Mighty Patch: Amazing and Immediate Results

Not only did this patch help get a very new very painful pimple to surface much earlier than it would have taken on its own, it also shortened the healing time to almost nothing when it would have otherwise been a painful week or two, the appearance of the pimple had improved in size it was much smaller and not nearly as inflamed or red, it didn't hurt at all after that, and I did not have any scarring. The results were almost immediate. I can not believe how well this little patch worked, I did not think that it was possible for a product to work this well, and especially not that fast. Love love love Hero!!!!

I tried these a couple of months ago and was happy to see that it worked and did reduce the appearance or breakouts. Definitely need to put on before any other face products so it sticks well. I will continue using these which have helped me reduce skin picking

This is a great tool for helping the subdermal blemishes rise to the surface of the skin, so you can then treat it with a regular patch. I had to use more than one patch to get it to work but overall still recommend.

avis.titre: BEST PIMPLE PATCHES FOR UNDERGROUND PIMPLES

It instantly caused my hyperpigmentation marks caused by hormonal acne to fade after only one use.
This is an amazing product and I'm so glad I found it. The only downside is that they only come in a six pack.
Best product ever to quickly reduce blemishes. Cannot live without it!

Received a sample and came here to buy a box. I had a pimple a day before an event. It literally shrank down by the next morning and was barely noticeable! I wasn't expecting the results I got and am very pleased.

I'm honestly amazed on how well these patches work and how quickly they make my breakouts disappear after trying a couple. A breakout that can last for weeks, almost gone within a few days. My only complaint is that there's not a lot of patches in each package.
Love the hero mighty patches! They are my all time favorite thing. Make my pimples vanish overnight!!

I've always suffered from horrible deep acne that would take weeks to clear up, and they would be painful. These patches work AMAZING. After one night with it on, it went down in size and wasn't painful.

This really is a rescue blemish patch. Becomes less painful and starts to become decreased in size at first use!

These patches are a lifesaving tool! I get deep cystic acne occasionally and I used only one of these patches on one that I could feel deep under my skin. It resolved without having to come to a head. I would definitely recommend these! They are easy to apply and the quality is amazing!

i had a super stubborn pimple and it got rid of it overnight!

it helps with deep pimples. however, i can't get them to stay on consistently despite holding it down for 30+ seconds. by the time the morning rolls around, there's a 50% chance they'll stay on. for this price point, i'd expect them to be perfect.
